Shallow Pockets.desc: Can only carry four unique items, any new ones will be dropped.

You Only Have Two Hands.desc: Can only carry two unique items, any new ones will be dropped.

I Always Come Back.desc: An immortal wall dweller will stalk you throughout the game, watch your back.

Porous Walls.desc: Nodes, including Pandemonium, can see you through walls, not recommended with Pure Pandemonium.

Hot Potato.desc: Crouch when warned with beeping or an indicator, otherwise death will follow.

Landyours.desc: Watch your step, landmines are more common.

Explosive Storage.desc: Drawers may contain landmines, step away as fast as possible.

Subspace Tripmine.desc: Landmines are replaced by Subspace Tripmines, they are now much harder to see.

Friendly.desc: A new Imaginary Friend spawns every 20 rooms, otherwise harmles.

Deception.desc: Upon spawning, Pandemonium will mimic an Angler or its variants, functions like normal otherwise.
